name: intentional-ux
description: Analyze interfaces, workflows, and agent capabilities from intention to verified outcome.

interface.shortDescription: Reduce friction from intention to outcome.
interface.longDescription: Analyze task paths, interaction costs, accessibility, frontend integrity, and capability resolution to improve completion and time to value.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this experience from intention to confirmed outcome.
Find avoidable hits, delays, cognitive load, and recovery costs in this task path.
Verify that this skill resolves to the intended source and produces observable task success.
